gloss_en: guarding the covenant (shmirat ha-brit) in both of its two aspects — the Supernal Unification (yichuda ila'ah) and the Lower Unification (yichuda tata'ah), i.e., Shabbat/weekday union, trees/grasses, Kabbalah/Halakhah — the dual sexual-covenantal purity practice in Likutey Moharan I:11 that brings God's honor to completeness
